items.name: CP2 LNG Phase 2 final investment decision and financial close
items.claim: Venture Global announced a final investment decision (FID) and successful closing of an $8.6 billion project financing for the second phase of Venture Global CP2 LNG (CP2), its third greenfield project.
items.source_excerpt: is announcing a final investment decision (FID) and successful closing of an $8.6 billion project financing for the second phase of the company’s third project, Venture Global CP2 LNG (CP2).
